compare.v1/verdict.instructions: Reply A is what the assistant answered to the request. Reply B is what another model answered to the same request. Does B do what A did, for this request?

criteria.same: B does what A did for this request: it gives the same answer or takes the same next step, whatever the wording, length, or order.
criteria.better: B does what A did and does it more completely or more correctly, so a person would prefer B.
criteria.weaker: B does less than A did: it leaves out something A gave or did, gets something wrong that A got right, or stops short.
criteria.different: B does something else than A did: a different answer, a different next step, or a different reading of the request, and neither is plainly the better.
criteria.other: None of the options above describes how B relates to A.
